clips.title: The story
paras: King Magni Bronzebeard holds court in High Seat, between the Commons and the Great Forge. His royal advisors and historians gather in the chamber, where a sealed passage leads down to Old Ironforge.

King Magni Bronzebeard hears petitioners and meets with his advisors in High Seat. Royal Historian Archesonus and Senator Barin Redstone stand among those at his side as he directs the defense of the Alliance's northern bastions. The chamber is the seat of power for the kingdom of Khaz Modan, and Magni leads from here amid troubling times across Azeroth.

A heavy doorway at the back of the throne room leads down into Old Ironforge. The lower ruins are the ancestral halls the dwarves carved before the city was reconfigured around the Great Forge. The passage is sealed and guarded, keeping general traffic from the ancient halls beneath the capital.
